_note: Sanctioned generic fallbacks: what a consumer may legitimately do when the authority has no specific answer. These are deliberately generic and must not be presented as canonical components.

fallbacks.title: Plain content on system surfaces
fallbacks.statement: Render plain content using the system type scale, spacing roles and layout tokens: system text styles on a system surface, no new visual language, no invented component skin.
constraints: mark the improvisation (code comment or note) so it is not mistaken for canon

fallbacks.title: Native control, token-conformant
fallbacks.statement: If no system control fits, use the platform's native element with minimal token-conformant styling; keep native semantics and degrade without JS.
constraints: no invented component presented as canonical

fallbacks.title: Omit and report
fallbacks.statement: When nothing sanctioned fits and any fallback would mislead users, omit the feature area rather than inventing canon, and report a gap.
constraints: a gap record is required when this fallback is used
